issues.title: [PM-01] Set up project board, branch protection and PR template
issues.goal: Everyone can see who is doing what this week, and nothing lands on main without review.
tasks: Run `planning/create_issues.py` to create labels, milestones and all issues
Create a GitHub Project (board view) with columns Backlog / This week / In progress / In review / Done; add every issue; group by milestone
Add Start date and Due date fields to the Project and copy the dates from each issue
Create `dev` branch; protect `main` and `dev` (PR required, 1 approval, CI must pass)
Agree working rules in README: branch per issue `feat/<key>-short-name`, PR into `dev`, squash merge
Book a 15-min daily stand-up and a weekly batch review (Sundays)
done: All issues on the board with owners and dates
Direct pushes to main are blocked

issues.title: [PM-02] Azure for Students subscription, team access and budget alerts
issues.goal: The team has one Azure subscription to deploy into, with alerts before the $100 credit runs out.
tasks: Activate Azure for Students on one account; create resource group `rg-cotender` in one region (South Africa North or West Europe)
Invite the platform and AI developers as Contributors on the resource group
Create budget alerts at $20 and $50 emailed to all four members
Start `docs/costs.md`: a table of each resource, SKU and expected monthly cost
done: Platform dev can create resources in the resource group
Budget alerts visible in Cost Management

issues.title: [PM-03] Collect 3+ real electrical tender packs into samples/
issues.goal: The AI dev has real RFQ/BoQ files (PDF text, scanned PDF, XLSX, DOCX) to build and test extractors against.
tasks: Get at least 3 electrical tender packs from municipal/public portals or contacts, with permission to use them
Include at least: one text PDF RFQ, one scanned PDF, one XLSX BoQ, one DOCX, one supplier quotation
Put them in `samples/<pack-name>/` with a `README.md` per pack (source, permission, what's inside)
Remove personal information (names, ID numbers, phone numbers) where possible
Keep files under 20 MB / 50 pages each (our upload limit)
done: samples/ has 3+ packs covering PDF, scan, XLSX and DOCX
AI dev confirms the files are usable

issues.title: [F1] Own the starter repo: Compose, CI, Docker image on every laptop
issues.goal:
**Starter kit provided.** The skeleton for this is already in the repo; your job is to review it, own it and finish what's listed below.

Every developer runs the same stack with one command, and every PR is checked automatically.
tasks: Run `make up` on all four laptops (Windows, Mac, Linux); fix anything that breaks and document it in README
Confirm `docker compose up` serves http://localhost:8000/docs and http://localhost:3000
Make CI required on `main` and `dev` (branch protection) once the first PR is green
Add Dependabot (pip + npm) and a `pip-audit` / `npm audit` CI step
Read `backend/app/core/` end to end so you can answer questions about it
done: `docker compose up` serves /health on :8000 and the Next.js page on :3000 on all four laptops
CI is green on an empty PR
